summary: Browser handoff URLs resolve only known storefronts and error on an unknown selector instead of opening Programada; a known store with an empty subdomain still uses programada so the host is never blank.
reason: resolveSubdomain used StoreFor, which falls back to Programada for unknown selectors. checkout open and the delivery, subscription, and card handoffs do not all go through newClient, so --store 99 silently opened programada.shopper.com.br. A blank --store remains the default storefront.
validated_outcome: TestUnknownStoreDoesNotOpenProgramada and TestOpenStorefrontPageRejectsUnknownStore fail --store 99 with no storefront URL. TestCheckoutURLNeverHasEmptySubdomain still refuses an empty host label, including the known-store empty-subdomain fallback.
